title: harness: skill-list-guard (run skill news before editing)
desc: Warns on Edit/Write if skill news or skill list was not run in the last 60 minutes. Prevents editing with stale skill knowledge.
steps: SAFETY: Fires when you Edit/Write without running 'wkappbot skill news' or 'wkappbot skill list' in the last 60min -- you may overwrite work done by a parallel session or miss a new skill that already solves your task.
SOLUTION: Run 'wkappbot skill news' (shows skills added/changed in 7 days) before making file edits. This clears the guard for 60 minutes.
PREVENTION: Start every session with 'wkappbot skill news' to stay current on new skills and avoid redundant work.
author: claude
